title: Agentic Provenance Record
description: Per-loop-iteration machine-readable provenance record. Generated automatically at loop completion; filed with the evidence bundle; retained for the operational lifetime of the system. Implements the ten required fields enumerated in manifesto-done.md (Agentic provenance record). STATUS: DRAFT — governance-authority signoff required.

loop_iteration_id.description: Stable identifier for this loop iteration; joins to the evidence bundle.

loop_completed_at.description: Timestamp of loop completion; record is generated at this moment, not assembled post-hoc.

model_identifier.description: Specific model used during the loop iteration.

fine_tune_or_adapter_identifier.description: Fine-tune / LoRA / adapter ID, if applicable.

provider_category.description: Category only; commercial vendor names are intentionally not captured.

deployment_mode.description: How the model was reached (e.g., managed endpoint, in-cluster inference, edge).

parity.description: True iff the model used during evaluation matches the model deployed to production.

divergence_justification.description: Required when parity=false. Documents why the evaluated configuration differs from the production configuration.

prompt_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of system instructions and prompts; plaintext is not stored. Enables change detection across iterations while protecting confidentiality.

tool_manifest.description: Complete list of tools, plugins, and integration servers available to the agent during the loop, with version and permission scope.

memory_state_version.description: Persistent memory state identifiers at loop entry and exit. Required where persistent memory is in use.

retrieval_corpus_version.description: Version identifier of any retrieval corpus, vector store, or knowledge base consulted during the loop. Required where retrieval augmentation is in use.

embedding_model_version.description: Embedding model used to generate retrieval embeddings, where applicable.

dataset_lineage.description: Lineage of the training or fine-tuning dataset for systems using fine-tuned or domain-adapted models.

policy_constraints_active.description: Set of safety, content, and behavioural policies in effect during the loop iteration.
